diagnosis: The upstream field discount_amount was renamed, so the transformation feeding SALES_DAILY could no longer resolve it and wrote NULL discounts.

steps.title: Restore field mapping
steps.description: Map orders_enriched.discount_amount to the renamed upstream field discount_value.

steps.title: Replay affected records
steps.description: Reprocess every order ingested since the schema change.

steps.title: Recompute revenue
steps.description: Recompute the daily aggregate for the impacted window.

steps.title: Validate downstream assets
steps.description: Re-run quality checks on the impacted downstream assets.

steps.title: Notify owners
steps.description: Inform the owning teams of the schema change and of the applied fix.

expected_result: Discount values are populated again and the daily revenue metric returns to its expected range.
rollback: Re-point the mapping to its previous source field; no record is removed at any step.

result.note: Controlled simulation only - no production system was modified.
